# Listowel Heating & Cooling

> Listowel Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Listowel, Waterloo Region, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (519) 291-3562  |  Email: contact@listowelheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://listowelheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Listowel, Cambridge, Kitchener, Waterloo, Elmira, New Hamburg, Baden, Breslau
